note: Local app: start the server first (cwd 'With a Toungue': .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m app.server). The injected CSS applies the intended [hidden] behaviour (the app's .overlay/.empty rules override it in Chromium). 'karaoke' plays the CACHED render only (kokoro/af_bella) - no model load; the browser is muted.

steps.eval: [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0 && /loading the voice model/i.test(e.textContent)).forEach(e=>{let t=e; const r=()=>t.getBoundingClientRect(); while(t.parentElement && t.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect().height<60 && t.parentElement!==document.body) t=t.parentElement; t.style.visibility='hidden';})
